scope: docs/product/adhd-first/01-06 and README; cross-reference old v0.2 gates and product index; 07/browser/isolation results intentionally pending
gateMeaning: Document review only; no claim that engineering Gate0 passed or human Gate1/2 were performed
reviewerIndependence: Cross-agent review of 01/03/05/06/README. The same reviewer authored 02/04 and sources.json earlier, so those are self-review, not independent third-party validation.

checks.question: ADHD difficulties are tied to concrete mechanisms
checks.detail: Six contexts map to next-step preservation, editable local tiny action, bounded choice, optional time and normal exit.

checks.question: Source types and retrieval depth are honest
checks.detail: Official, coach experience, primary research, product and hypotheses separated. CHADD origin 403/index body and excluded unread study lead stated.

checks.question: No invented human research or efficacy result
checks.detail: Zero participants and lack of real value validation explicit; Tiny Start ranking is a product judgment.

checks.question: Lives-language examples not presented as quotations
checks.detail: Scenario utterances marked hypothetical; user-provided friend's situation remains a stakeholder report.

checks.question: Three brand candidates compare misleading implications
checks.detail: Saved-progress promise and automatic tracking risk evaluated; selected language scoped to task assistance.

checks.question: Interesting interaction is seriously retained without reward loop
checks.detail: Three-piece deterministic tactile option implemented as a candidate, not dismissed by a blanket low-stimulation preference. No replay default, scores or random rewards.

checks.question: Direct Resume and user control remain available
checks.detail: Single primary action; four needs only after request; no diagnosis mode or forced timer.

checks.question: No medical or phone capability misrepresentation
checks.detail: No diagnosis, treatment, neurotransmitter claim, mobile detection, screen-use permission or real-task QR transfer.

checks.question: Measure first actual action without forcing it after timer/Resume

resolution.detail: Phase1 now permits first action during optional assistance and before return click; neutral retrospective wording added. Phase2 asks whether and when action occurred during/after assistance or after return.

checks.question: Phase1 denominators include refusal and exit
checks.detail: N1 includes direct-only/refusal/exit; Np offered, Ap started; faults and missing shown, withdrawals recalculate per consent.

checks.question: Phase2 denominators distinguish need, non-use and attrition
checks.detail: N2v/N2r/N2need distinct; not recalled/not opened retained; attrition is not automatically counted as failure.

checks.question: Consent and true-task exclusion are compatible
checks.detail: Separate consent to record; no clinical data/recording; real next step can remain private outside the prototype. Field probe explicitly cannot validate production task binding.

checks.question: PRD provides falsifiable acceptance and negative examples
checks.detail: P0-01 through P0-16 specify observable contracts for branches, local suggestions, source labels, time, conflicts, failures, language, access and isolation. Passing is not asserted by listing requirements.

checks.question: Historical v0.2 conclusions are not rewritten as new evidence
evidence: git diff scoped old product files
checks.detail: Old PRD/decisions/research/gates have no current content diff. Old skills workflow only has a dated four-line addition.

checks.question: New/old gate numbering migration is clear

resolution.detail: Explicit mapping now distinguishes new Gate1/2 research and Gate3 formal engineering from old v0.2 Gate2 formal engineering.

checks.question: README is usable without confusing demo and deployed product
checks.detail: Clean-clone install, local start, new/old ports and standalone demo status explicit. 07 and final engineering attachments deferred intentionally.

checks.question: Research notation can be transcribed unambiguously

resolution.detail: Explicit instruction distinguishes route S from evidence S and requires full column names.

findings.title: Tiny Start action may occur before the return click
findings.detail: End-of-branch script and phase2 question assume first action follows Resume. Tiny Start is intended to let people act during its optional 30 seconds or immediately without a timer. A host following the script literally could wait for completion or miss valid early action, biasing the main measure.
findings.suggestion: Start observation from expressed intent. Explicitly allow tAction earlier than timer expiry/tResume; never require waiting or a return click before action. Ask whether/when an action occurred instead of only asking what happened after Resume.
findings.blocks: Resolve before real participant sessions; does not block local prototype/source delivery.

resolution.detail: Phase1 now permits first action during optional assistance and before return click; neutral retrospective wording added. Phase2 asks whether and when action occurred during/after assistance or after return.

findings.title: Old and new Gate2 refer to different decisions
findings.detail: Old v0.2 Gate2 means formal integration readiness. New v0.2b Gate2 means real-session probe and Gate3 means formal integration. Historical preservation is correct, but cross-reading both lists could mistake readiness states.
findings.suggestion: Add a short mapping: v0.2b Gate0 engineering, Gate1 exploration, Gate2 real-session probe, Gate3 formal integration; old v0.2 Gate2 roughly corresponds to new Gate3.

resolution.detail: Explicit mapping now distinguishes new Gate1/2 research and Gate3 formal engineering from old v0.2 Gate2 formal engineering.

findings.title: S denotes both a route and self-report evidence
findings.detail: The rotation table uses S for Tiny Spark while the evidence table uses S for self-report. Context disambiguates the document, but manually filling an observation table could create ambiguous shorthand.
findings.suggestion: Use SP or route:Spark for the route, or add an explicit instruction to put route and evidence code in separate columns.

resolution.detail: Explicit instruction distinguishes route S from evidence S and requires full column names.
